module: Vehicle seat and occupant system. It records which player (or dummy occupant) occupies which seat of each vehicle (occupancy[vehId][seatId]) and the "presence" of each player (vehicle, optional seat, permission mode). It applies the occupants' weight to the vehicle, shows or hides occupant meshes (depending on the camera and the enableSeatOccupants setting), handles the seat camera, the blocking of driving controls for a passenger (action maps mask) and exiting the vehicle. Vehicles without a seat configuration (occupantSystem / occupantSlotsById in the JBeam data) do not go through this system. Useful to modders for putting a player in a specific seat, adding weighted dummy passengers or finding out who is driving.
usage:
-- seat player 0 as a passenger in seat "RR"
gameplay_seatOccupants.requestEnterSeat(vehId, 'RR', 0)
-- add an 80 kg dummy passenger
gameplay_seatOccupants.setDummyOccupant(vehId, 'FR', 80)
print(dumps(gameplay_seatOccupants.getSeats(vehId)))
notes: Permission modes (gameplay/vehiclePresencePolicy): 'driver' (driving controls), 'passenger' (no controls), 'unrestricted' (all). Without a seat, the default mode is 'unrestricted' in freeroam outside multiseat, otherwise 'passenger'.
Default occupant weight: 89 (kg). cheeseburger / salad add / remove 10 kg to all occupants of the vehicle, clamped between 49 and 119.

Seat identifiers (seatId) come from the vehicle's "<seatId>Occupant" cargo groups (for example FL, FR). The driver seat is the one whose defaultPermissionMode is 'driver', otherwise FR (right-hand drive) or FL.
Unicycle (walking) is excluded from the seat system.

Debug fields: debugDisableOccupantSystem restores the old behavior (everyone 'unrestricted', no seats); debugDisableOccupantWeight; enablePresenceDebugMessages displays presence changes; enableSeatEjection (false by default) lets enterSeat eject the current occupant of an occupied seat and take their place.
Serialization: version 2 ({version, playerPresence, seatClaims, occupancy}); restoration also accepts the old "occupancy"-only format.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded beforehand (core_camera, core_vehicle_manager, core_input_actionFilter, core_gamestate, core_multiseat, ui_vehicleSelector_vehicleSpecifications).

enableSeatEjection.desc: If true, enterSeat ejects (walking mode) the player already seated in this seat (false by default).

enablePresenceDebugMessages.desc: Displays a message on each presence change (false by default).

debugDisableOccupantWeight.desc: Debug: disables adding the occupants' weight (false by default).

debugDisableOccupantSystem.desc: Debug: disables the whole seat system and reverts to the old behavior (false by default).

usesSeatSystem.desc: Indicates whether the vehicle uses the seat system (occupantSystem.enabled, otherwise presence of occupant slots in the vehicle data). Always false if debugDisableOccupantSystem.

returns.desc: true if the vehicle has managed seats.

getOccupantSystemVersion.desc: Declared version of the occupant system in the vehicle data.

canEnterVehicle.desc: Indicates whether the player can enter the vehicle (vehicle switching or walking allowed).

showVehicleFullMessage.desc: Shows the "vehicle full" UI message to the player.

getPlayerPresence.desc: Copy of a player's presence in a vehicle.

setPlayerPermissionMode.desc: Changes the permission mode of a player already present in a vehicle.

setOccupied.desc: Places a player in a seat (no animation or vehicle change). Frees their other seats, records the presence, applies the weight, updates the controls and the camera.

returns.desc: false if invalid vehicle, invalid seat or unavailable seat.

clearOccupied.desc: Frees seats. Without a second argument: all occupants of the vehicle. With a number: removes that player from all vehicles.

seatIdOrPlayer.desc: Nil for the whole vehicle, a number for a player; a seat name is handled by the rest of the function (inferred from code).

enterSeat.desc: Entry point of a seat's "enterSeat" trigger: finds the seat from the trigger then calls requestEnterSeat. In debug mode, enters 'unrestricted' without a seat.

requestEnterSeat.desc: Asks a player to sit in a given seat, entering the vehicle if needed (on foot or by switching vehicle). If the player is already in this seat, they exit (switch to walking mode). Shows a message if the seat is taken, if the player cannot leave their seat, or if the vehicle is not accessible.

returns.desc: true if the player ends up in this seat (or exits); nil if vehId or seatId is missing.

requestEnterBestSeat.desc: Picks a free seat (taking the walking position into account if any) and seats the player there. With no free seat, falls back to unseated presence if the default mode is 'unrestricted', otherwise shows "vehicle full".

walkingPos.desc: Position of the player on foot, used to pick the nearest seat.

returns.desc: nil if the vehicle does not use the seat system.

requestUnseatedPresence.desc: Places a player in the vehicle without a seat ("unseated" presence), with an optional permission mode.

returns.desc: true if the unseated presence is established.

switchSeat.desc: Moves to the next free seat (direction > 0) or the previous one (direction < 0) of the current vehicle, with the driver at the head of the list.

returns.desc: true if a seat was taken.

toggleUnseated.desc: Toggles between "seated" and "unseated" in the current vehicle.

getSeats.desc: Lists the seats of a vehicle with their state.

returns.desc: Items {seatId, isDriver, occupied, occupantType ('player'|'dummy'), player, weight, color, permissionMode, displayName, defaultPermissionMode, cameraName, actionMaps, seatExitNode, seatExitSide, partPath, seatPartPath}.

getVehiclePresences.desc: List of player presences in a vehicle, sorted by player.

getDriverPlayer.desc: Lowest player index allowed to drive the vehicle ('driver' or 'unrestricted' mode).

returns.desc: Driver index, nil if there are only passengers.

setDummyOccupant.desc: Places a dummy occupant (randomly colored mesh) with a weight in a free seat.

clearDummyOccupant.desc: Removes the dummy occupant from a seat.

returns.desc: 'notDummy' if there is nothing to remove.

clearDummyOccupants.desc: Removes all dummy occupants from a vehicle, or from all vehicles if vehId is nil.

cheeseburger.desc: Adds 10 kg to each occupant (clamped to 119) and displays a message with the weight.

returns.desc: Displayed weight, nil if no occupant.

salad.desc: Removes 10 kg from each occupant (clamped to 49) and displays a message with the weight.

returns.desc: Displayed weight, nil if no occupant.

setVehicleOccupantsEnabledOverride.desc: Forces the display (true) or hiding (false) of a vehicle's occupants, regardless of the global setting; nil removes the override.

returns.desc: false if the vehicle does not exist.

refreshOccupantMeshes.desc: Reasserts the visibility of occupant meshes after a change made without going through the sync hooks (used by gameplay_traffic).

getSeatExitData.desc: Computes where the player exits the vehicle: a point beside the body, on the seat side (exitNode/exitSide of the slot, otherwise side inferred from the position), offset 0.7 m beyond the body.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook: the player changes vehicle; updates their occupancy.

onCameraChanged.desc: Hook: a player's camera changes; updates occupant visibility (e.g. hide the head in first-person view).

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook: reapplies the occupant visuals (enableSeatOccupants setting).

onSplitScreenChanged.desc: Hook: recalculates presences and visuals after a split-screen change.

onLocalParticipantsChanged.desc: Hook: recalculates presences and visuals when the local participants change.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook: reapplies weight and visuals for a vehicle that has just appeared.

onBeforeVehicleReplaced.desc: Hook before a vehicle is replaced: remembers whether it had no seat system.

onVehicleReplaced.desc: Hook after replacement: reapplies the state and reassigns unseated players.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook: reapplies weight and visuals after a reset.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: frees all occupancy and presence data of the destroyed vehicle.

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook: clears occupant overrides and occupies player 0's current vehicle.

onBeforeWalkingModeToggled.desc: Hook before the walking mode toggle: if the player switches to walking, lifts the driving block.

onVehicleTriggerActionLabel.desc: Hook to customize the label and icon of the "enterSeat" action of a seat trigger ("Sit here", driver or passenger seat).

data.desc: Modified table (actionName, vehicleId, player, title, icon).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: restores the serialized state if it exists, otherwise occupies the existing players.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook: removes the overrides, restores the cameras and frees the action maps mask.

onSerialize.desc: Hook: serializes presences and occupied seats before a Lua reload.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook: restores the state after a Lua reload.
